recursion.retain: first 30 of 42 concatenated final model outputs
recursion.demand_feedback: own scenario final fused prediction, unrounded, no observations after cutoff
recursion.state: reset all internal recurrent states for each model invocation
recursion.historical_exogenous: supplied values for each date, with scenario interventions retained

individual_ablation.replacement: normalization.json training mean for that variable, applied before scaling
individual_ablation.attribution: full minus ablated prediction in original demand units

numerics.scaling: x * scale + offset using normalization.json; no fitting and no clipping
numerics.feedback: keep unrounded scaled model output; implementations with equivalent numerics are accepted

top5.json.selected_features: 1 to 15 distinct meteorological feature names; fixed for all cutoffs; not required to match attention ranking
top5.json.mean_attention: object mapping all 16 meteorological feature names to finite mean weights

csv_format.ordering: cutoff_date ascending, lead_day ascending, feature ASCII ascending when present
csv_format.coverage: exact keys; no duplicates, extra columns, extra rows, index column, NaN or infinity

grader_owned_diagnostics.performance: RMSE degradation is a pass/fail criterion (<=10%); other metrics diagnostic only

attention_summary.attention: MeteorologicalVariableAttention returned weights, unperturbed model in eval mode
attention_summary.window_note: Reproduce original range(L-(7+14)); intentionally excludes the last mathematically possible window.
attention_summary.aggregation: arithmetic mean over all 3314 windows, accumulate in float64

feature_selection.ranking_requirement: none; no required selection algorithm or attention ranking
feature_selection.selection_data: chronological development data only; no held-out observed demand
feature_selection.excluded_feature_replacement: training mean from normalization.json before scaling
feature_selection.reduced_history: replace excluded features in original 7-day historical meteorological window
feature_selection.reduced_future: replace excluded features in all 42 supplied future exogenous days
feature_selection.metric: pooled RMSE over 270 cutoff/lead records, equal weight
feature_selection.criterion: RMSE_reduced <= 1.10 * RMSE_full on same private held-out observed demand

pairwise_interaction.features: all 120 unordered pairs of 16 meteorological variables
pairwise_interaction.persistence: intervened future values persist when later entering recursive history
pairwise_interaction.formula: full - single_i - single_j + joint_ij in original demand units

reproducibility.identical_inputs: same selected subset and numerically equivalent output files
